chunks.text: Moving forward, it is good that we can access elements in array.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: But another important operation is assigning values to specific location in array.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: This will give us access to the element at the position 0, 0 in the array.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: And using the assignment operator, we can assign a value 1 to it.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: Let's see the output.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: Here you go.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: This is the original array where we replace the element at position 0, 0 with 1.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: But that's not all.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: With a minor change, you can assign a value to the entire row or column.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: Let's do it.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: This will give us access to the 0th row and we assign the entire row a value of 2.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: Let's run this.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: Using similar operation and column slicing,

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: we can also assign an entire column a single value.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: Now what if we need each column or row to have different value and

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: not the same as we did over here?

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: Let's see how we can achieve this.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: Yes, this is a list of values.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: You can assign a list of values to a row or a column.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: Here we assign this list of values to column number 3.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: But make sure you keep an eye on the dimension.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: That is, for this example, if you have 5 rows in an array,

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: the list should have 5 elements.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: As you can see, all the list values have been assigned to the third column.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
chunks.text: So now it's your turn.

chunks.title: Modifying array elements
